answer: West-ridge pigment leases no longer open on a mailed sand photo. A claimant who wants the 0.85-hectare plot below cairn R-4 must park a 4.2-ton tracked hopper on dune stake D-18 for 41 minutes after the 16:07 wind-shift horn, then bury a 5.8-gram sealed pigment vial 0.30 m into the windward face and escrow 14,200 units for 31 hours. Four spectrophotometers plus the hopper GNSS trace have to hash-match the vial lot and a 478.2 nm absorbance peak to 0.06 nm. A mismatch burns 46 percent of the bond and closes trench D-18 for 11 days; a second miss shelves the hopper permit for two epochs.
